name: Cross Letter
source:
Two love letters arrive for the protagonist.

What follows is a bizarre adventure surrounding them.

It may seem like a school romance at first, but it leans heavily into comedy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=932004]Melonbooks[/url]]
